learning_outcomes.text: Understand how to plan radio networks.
Be able to identify and apply tasks in the field of radio networks.

syllabus_topics: Basic terms, units, quantities, connectors used in radio communication technology.
Distribution of the frequency spectrum, properties of the radio channel, types of signals, general scheme of the radio communication chain
Basic units and equations used in radio communication, radio communication equations
teaching_methods: Teaching by an expert (lecture or tutorial)
